dedupe_keys.name: ovsv repeater digipeater and beacon database and maps austria

description: The VHF department of the ÖVSV, the Austrian amateur radio association, maintains a database of amateur radio repeaters, digipeaters and beacons in Austria. Besides an interactive repeater map, the page offers an interactive list taken directly from the database, a PDF list of repeaters and digipeaters, and downloadable maps for FM repeaters, the FM OE-Link network, DMR, C4FM, D-STAR, beacons, digipeaters, TETRA and ATV, dated 8 September 2025, and it explains the list fields such as the transmit frequency and the CTCSS tone of each repeater. The association also publishes the database code as an open-source project on GitHub. The information is provided under the CC BY 4.0 licence and is free to use. Caveats: the page is in German, the maps are snapshots at the stated date, and the entries describe volunteer-run amateur stations, not public infrastructure. Coverage is Austria. It supports emergency response and communication resilience studies, such as mapping backup radio links that remain when public networks fail; related records are HamnetDB and the amateur satellite database.
